description: The rb_u250_rocket FireSim bitstream (FireSimRiskyBirdRocketConfig -> chipyard.RocketConfig on xilinx_alveo_u250, 30 MHz host): ONE Rocket hart, no vector unit, no Gemmini. Every dispatch runs on the scalar backend on hart 0, so a schedule built against this registry is necessarily serialized -- there is no second worker to overlap onto. Use chipyard_dual_rocket_gemmini_q31.json instead when a 2-hart saturn+gemmini_q31 bitstream is available; that is the machine the shipped gemmini_q31 and V256D128_rvv profiles were captured on.

cores.name: rocket0
cores.description: Rocket, rv64gc, no RVV and no ROCC accelerator. Runs the MODELBLASTER_BACKEND=scalar reference kernels for every op.
